body: As I step closer to the loft, the dim light seems to flicker, casting eerie shadows around the old wooden pews. A faint hum emanates from a small, glowing box nestled between the pews, its wires and circuits exposed in a messy tangle. My curiosity piqued, I carefully approach the box, trying not to disturb anything.
